descriptionChirho: Intransitive stative sense (Qal): to be fine, become small or thin, describing the resultant state of something reduced to fine particles or dust.
Transitive causative sense (primarily Hifil, also Qal active): to crush, grind, pulverize, beat to fine powder or dust, including stamping or pounding into pieces.
Passive sense (Hofal): to be crushed, ground, or pulverized by an external agent, as grain is ground into flour.
